verdict.rationale: Reflect publishes a documented public REST API with OAuth 2 and PKCE, bearer-token auth, and a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 spec linked from its docs. The spec covers listing graphs, getting and creating links, appending to daily notes, creating notes, and GET /users/me with read/write scopes. The surface is narrow by design: end-to-end encryption means the API cannot return note contents, so an agent can mostly write and append rather than read, search, or fully operate the product. Missing for 10: read access to note contents, search or AI features via the API, versioning and deprecation policy, a sandbox or test environment, the OpenAPI spec on the vendor's own domain (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
